ui.description: Join, merge or combine two FIT files into one activity: fix a run or ride you accidentally stopped and saved halfway. Works with Garmin, Strava, Wahoo, Coros and more. Free, no data lost, runs in your browser.
ui.tagline: Join two FIT files into one activity
ui.lede: Stopped and saved your run halfway by accident? Join the two activities back into one, as if you had paused instead of saving. No data is lost.
ui.private: Your files stay on this device: everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
ui.export_p: On Garmin Connect, open each activity, then ⚙ → Export Original (you get a .zip). On Strava, open each activity, then ⋯ → Export Original. Files from other apps work if they are .fit files.
ui.drop: Drop the .fit or .zip files here, or <u>choose files</u>
ui.load_failed: Could not load the Python runtime: {0}
ui.force: Stitch even if the sport or the device differ
ui.one_more: Add at least one more part.
ui.verify_failed: Verification failed, so no file was produced. Please report this as a bug.
ui.replace_p: Delete the original parts on Garmin Connect and on Strava first: both reject an upload with the same start time as an existing activity. Kudos, comments, photos and titles on the parts are lost. Then upload the stitched file on Garmin Connect (Import Data). If it doesn't reach Strava on its own, upload it at strava.com/upload.
